outcome: percentage of adequate umbilical cord blood (UCB) collections (>=70 mL)
cohort: The study participants were near-term infants delivered via caesarean section.
finding: A sufficient umbilical cord blood volume (>=70 mL) was obtained in approximately half of the collection attempts, and a higher birth weight was positively associated with a larger UCB volume.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on umbilical cord blood collection from infants delivered through caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between November 2023 and December 2024.
